notes: Local playback fixed — two real defects, both silent. (1) x-file-cifs:// URIs used the Bonjour '.local' hostname, which Sonos cannot resolve to its registered share; measured across four speakers, the short name played on all four and '.local' on two, which is why this presented as intermittent and zone-specific. LibrarySource.host keeps the '.local' form for the phone's own SMB connection; SourceResolver.sonosHost derives the Sonos-facing name. (2) Single-track playback pointed SetAVTransportURI straight at the file. Local content must be QUEUED — verified on a speaker that had refused every direct attempt for hours, where a one-track queue played immediately. Albums already queued, which is why they worked while single tracks did not, and why transfers failed: a destination inherits whatever the transport holds, and a bare file URI travels badly. Both answers were already written down in sorriva-local-playback-arch.md and unfindable because nothing pointed at it — so Sonos command sequences are now consolidated into engineering/sonos-playback-contract.md, the single authority, indexed in CLAUDE.md as a precondition for playback work, with the duplicate and contradictory copies removed from CLAUDE.md, the UPnP reference and the arch doc. PHASE D: polling demoted to transport-only — six station-field write sites removed and two whole functions deleted (fetchAllStationMetadata and restoreZoneStateFromDB), removing a SOAP call per zone per topology refresh and the freshness-stamp forging that caused zones to revert to 'last playing minus one'. Three views migrated onto the store, which also fixed an iHeart remove-station warning that could never fire. TESTS: first playback test suite — 17 reducer tests, every one validated by reintroducing its bug and confirming it goes red. Station resolution no longer re-resolves on every poll.
